faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Simple answers about privacy, data, and how tracking works.
faq.q1: Are all suppliers really based in the UK?
faq.a1: Can I use this with my existing store? Yes, NephroReach operates with verified global suppliers while ensuring strict local compliance and high quality standards.
faq.q2: How does VAT work with DropClicker?
faq.a2: VAT calculations and tax compliance are automatically processed based on your billing region during account setup.
faq.a3: Average processing and delivery time ranges between 3 to 5 business days depending on your target location.
faq.q4: Can I use this with my existing store?
faq.a4: Yes, our platform seamlessly integrates with popular digital platforms, e-commerce stores, and member portals.
faq.a5: We accept all major credit cards, Visa, Mastercard, PayPal, and direct secure bank transfers.
faq.q6: Is there a trial period available?
faq.a6: Yes! You can start with our 14-day free trial on any membership tier without entering credit card details.
faq.q7: How do I track my order status?
faq.a7: You can track your real-time status, journal updates, and active check-ins anytime inside your NephroReach dashboard.
